text:
mike: Deploybot just surfaced a p95 latency jump in eu-west-1 after the kernel flag flip. I'm holding the rollout. Do we want autopilot rollback or manual staged unwind?

deploybot: [ALERT] rollout r-80123: latency p95 +48% (baseline 190ms -> 282ms) over 3m window. Triggered rule: kernel-flag-change + traffic-shift. Suggestion: pause + pin.

oncall-bot: Pager triggered for r-80123 (severity: medium). Paging oncall@infra.

sophia: agree with pause + pin. auto-rollback is risky until we confirm no correctness regressions. we can pin affected instances and roll forward with previous kernel on new hosts.

mike: timeline? customer-impact seems limited to eu-west-1 but could bleed into global if autoscale pulls new hosts.

linus: quick plan: 1) `redwoodctl rollout pause --id r-80123 --region eu-west-1` 2) `redwoodctl pin-version --pool dedicated-eu --version v2.3.0` 3) revert kernel flag on canary hosts 4) monitor 10m -> decide rollforward vs full rollback.

linus: running pause now.

linus: ```
$ redwoodctl rollout pause --id r-80123 --region eu-west-1
=> rollout r-80123 paused (region=eu-west-1)
```

deploybot: Pause acknowledged. Traffic slice 0.12 moved to pinned variant.

sophia: i'll draft the quick cust note for impacted Dedicated customers: short note, ETA for mitigation ~30m, no data loss, monitoring update. ping me for signoff.

mike: +1 on customer note. sophia pls tag sales-ops and support.

sophia: tagging now: @sales-ops @support :loudspeaker: (draft) "We're pausing a staged rollout in eu-west-1 after observing latency regressions; mitigation in progress, will update in 30m."

deploybot: Telemetry after pause: p95 trending down to +12% (240ms). KV cache warmup in progress.

mike: linus, proceed with pin command when ready. confirm after pin.

linus: pinning pool.

linus: ```
$ redwoodctl pin-version --pool dedicated-eu --version v2.3.0 --reason "safety pin after kernel flag mismatch"
=> pool dedicated-eu pinned to v2.3.0
```

deploybot: Pin applied. New allocations will use v2.3.0; existing warm instances unaffected until drain.

sophia: sending customer note + posting to status page now. will attach runbook steps and contact channel.

mike: monitoring 5m window. if p95 < +15% keep pinned and schedule proper rollout with kernel rollback; if > +20% we escalate to full rollback and notify CSMs.

oncall-bot: Update: 5m window elapsed for r-80123, p95 = +14% (within threshold). No further action required for now.

sophia: nice. i'll open a follow-up ticket to coordinate kernel-flag revert and a controlled canary for next attempt.

mike: thanks everyone. capture this in release notes section: "staged rollout paused in eu-west-1 due to kernel-flag induced latency spike; pool pinned to v2.3.0; mitigation applied." closing thread after postmortem. :thumbsup:
